en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Khalid Bin Ayman Al Hannat, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The man must not be made to swear except what is based upon his knowledge’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from Khalid ibn Ayman al-Hannat from abu Basir who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A man must not be asked to take an oath except for what he knows.’”
